description: Use when deploying, tuning, or troubleshooting Suricata as a network intrusion detection sensor on a network you are authorized to monitor. Covers sensor placement and capture setup, rule syntax and Emerging Threats rulesets, EVE JSON logging, TLS and JA3 fingerprinting, performance tuning for high throughput, suppressing false positives, and feeding alerts into the SIEM. Use when the SOC needs network visibility, when tuning noisy NIDS alerts, or when validating a sensor deployment.
